Owned regional body-hair density, length, distribution, skin attachment, individual-fiber thickness and pigmentation, separate from skin finish, scalp hair, facial hair and eyebrow or lash styling.

Bounded natural, declared or applied markings on the owned body surface of an explicitly declared human or nonhuman actor, including a selected creature or machine-body design; owner and surface boundaries remain explicit.
Explicit orientation of an identified body or relative rotation of its declared connected regions, including biological, mechanical and represented bodies.
Explicit whole-body posture, support or articulation of an identified biological, mechanical or represented body, without inferring unmentioned anatomy.
Named anatomical region or selected body part, distinct from the obligation to prove its visibility.
Owned eyebrow-hair shape, strand arrangement, grooming or cosmetic line, separate from expression-related elevation, lowering or convergence of the brow relative to facial landmarks.
Explicit day type or calendar interval such as weekday, weekend or eve, distinct from clock time and named occasion.
Camera viewing axis and roll relative to the subject, distinct from height, distance and body orientation.

Declared acquisition device class, distinct from its mounting and from the image's imitation of a device look.

Purpose, access, observational circumstances and recording context of photography, not apparatus geometry.
Contrast between a declared character's visible bearing, local response, role or status.

Placement and distribution of cosmetic pigment on the declared cheek area.

Image-wide or specified tonal-band color and tone transformations, preserving locked local colors.

Arrangement of declared elements and negative space within one frame.
A declared conceptual contrast embodied by identifiable owners or states, not an unsupported abstract label.
Explicit contact, support or occlusion relation with each endpoint and owner identified.
Spatial occupancy and density of a declared group within the frame, with actor counts preserved.
Explicitly declared personal origin or background used as context, never inferred from appearance.
Depth extent of acceptable sharpness and background or foreground blur, separate from focus-plane selection.
Local wear, utilities and use traces owned by environmental surfaces or fixtures.
Recorded exposure, clipping and preservation of tonal information, separate from incident light level.

Observable facial or eye-area response belonging to one declared human or animal, or visibly presented by an explicitly declared artificial face or face representation. Owned facial shape, local anatomical geometry and proportions, separate from cosmetic contour or skin finish.
Facial hair form, length and distribution, including a visibly shaved state.
An explicitly selected fetish styling context with appropriate adult scope, not a material-only inference.
A coherent visual emulation of a named film or photographic medium, without claiming the medium was actually used.
Placement and priority of the focus plane and relative sharpness of named planes.

Relation of a garment's volume and contour to its declared wearer, without inferring body shape from clothing.

Target of the declared actor's gaze, with head orientation and eye state treated separately.
Explicit visual gender presentation without inferring sex, gender identity, personality or orientation.
Photographic genre and the conventions of the work, distinct from equipment and world rules.

Static shape and articulation of owned hands and fingers, with support and contact represented separately.

Level of illumination reaching a declared receiver, distinct from recorded exposure and tone mapping.
Illumination softness, angular extent and resulting shadow transition, separate from intensity and image exposure.
Explicit spatial geometry of illumination, highlights or shadow boundaries on an identified receiving surface or within a declared illuminated spatial region.
Light-source type and emission mechanism, distinct from exposure trails and image artifacts.
A coherent illumination setup combining source, spatial placement and receiving surfaces.
Bounded lip pigment regions, opacity, concentration and color transitions.
Optical surface finish of the owned lips, separate from pigment placement and lip anatomy.

Individually distinguishable particles, aggregates or bounded gas pockets located within an explicitly declared continuous liquid, including units at a submerged surface, with both units and liquid host grounded.
Physical place and structural setting of the scene, distinct from use state or world rules.
Cosmetic contour and highlight placement across facial planes, separate from actual facial geometry.
Cosmetic painted or attached skin decoration, distinct from natural markings and garment ornament.
A coherent combination of cosmetic treatments, distinct from an isolated cosmetic component.
Current distribution, transfer or loss of an owned cosmetic layer, without inferring elapsed time or cause.
Physical photographic acquisition or display medium and the image-bearing substrate.
Emotional atmosphere or proposed affective reading of the scene, not a measured state of air or a proven private emotion.
Image-plane freezing, streaks or blur from declared motion and capture, separate from physical action itself.
Visible shape, length, color, finish or decoration of an owned fingernail or toenail plate, separate from skin marks and joint pose.
An owned visible clue supporting a declared event interpretation, with observation and inferred chronology kept separate.
Central event, problem or relationship organizing the scene, distinct from a world system or a title alone.
Selected instant or phase within an explicitly declared human, natural, mechanical or other event, distinct from clock time, a named occasion and inferred chronology.
Visible non-anatomical geometry, bounded parts and structural connections owned by one declared physical object or fixture, independent of its scene role, frame placement and current use state.
Explicit occasion, ceremony or scheduled event shaping the scene, distinct from any arbitrary process step.
Explicitly declared off-frame participants, events or space and their visible relation, not automatically added actors.
Explicit participation or relational role of a declared participant, whether primary or secondary, without inferring identity, occupation or a new counterpart from appearance.
Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.
Crop-safe and interface-safe placement for a declared output platform, separate from aspect ratio.
Visible personal presentation and grooming, without inferring profession, personality or identity.
One identified step in a declared procedure, not a claim that a sequence was observed in one still image.
An explicitly owned scene object serving a declared role; placement and state are separate properties.
Position and orientation of owned props relative to named actors, surfaces and boundaries.
Owned object's current use, attachment, readiness, damage or arrangement state, with occupational context optional.
Physical spacing and access barriers between declared participants, without automatically inferring intimacy or intent.
Context of an external publication caption and how it frames interpretation, not text inside the image.
A declared ordinary reference whose relation makes a selected extraordinary concept legible.
Correspondence or intended discrepancy between an owned physical object and its reflected image.
Concrete interaction with explicitly declared action endpoints, including biological, mechanical or represented participants and their objects.
Comparative size relation between explicitly identified entities with a stated depth or perspective basis.
Explicit seasonal setting or its declared observable cues, not a season inferred from one ambiguous object.
Observable proxy for a proposed touch, heat, smell or sound interpretation, without claiming the sensation was measured.
Declared caster, receiving surface and shadow correspondence, separate from reflection and light-level claims.
Extent of subject coverage relative to the photograph's field, without equating it to focal length or physical distance.
Owned body or clothed silhouette proportions, with body and garment carriers explicitly distinguished.
Concrete local circumstances explaining the scene's event, distinct from genre, world rules and a named occasion.
Current observable skin state, separate from durable markings, cosmetic layers and unproven diagnosis.
Optical finish and microtexture of the owned skin surface, not body hair, geometry or private health state.
Owned skin color and local color variation under declared illumination and white balance, distinct from cosmetics and image grading; apparent color does not prove intrinsic pigment or identity.
Visible reactions, attention or allocation relations supporting a declared social reading.
Current use, preparation, maintenance or damage state of the place, distinct from structural location.
Depth ordering, overlap and perspective relations among foreground, middle distance and background owners.
Anatomical species cues owned by a declared subject, distinct from detachable costume ornaments.
Declared posed, candid or directed presentation, without claiming unobserved camera awareness as fact.
The primary declared visible entity or entities that the photograph is about.
Explicit number and grouping of declared visible or required participants.
Inclusion, crop and visibility of named subjects or body regions, with explicit owner and participant count.
Declared surface material and observable optical response; chemical identity and performance require separate context.
Explicit wetness, dampness, dryness or bounded moisture state of an identified physical surface, distinct from surface material, texture and optical sheen.

Bounded visible motif geometry and its layout, adjacency or explicitly stated repetition on one declared non-anatomical surface or design field, independent of physical surface microstructure, material identity, local hue and whole-frame composition.
Explicitly intended departure from ordinary reality through one identifiable scene rule.
Local observable consequence of a selected impossible rule, distinct from ordinary coherence checks.
Physical surface organization, roughness and repeated structure, not image-plane grain, compression or air particles.
Explicit physical temperature state or temperature change of an identified carrier, separate from illumination color temperature, emotional warmth and a sensory proxy.
Time within a day or natural-light cycle; event stage and calendar occasion are separate.
Observable stage of an explicitly selected transformation in body, form or material.
Observer's declared position and participation relation in the scene, separate from geometric camera settings.
Explicit visible lettering, symbols and placement within the photograph, distinct from an external publication caption.
Amount and distribution of visible information, independent of the number of people.
Declared order and prominence in which visible owners should be read.
Explicit order, overlap and exposure of separately owned garment layers.
Overall outfit combination and styling of a declared wearer, distinct from garment details.
Accessory visibly worn by a declared owner, with attachment and location preserved.
Declared weather and its observable effects, separate from airborne material and unsupported causal inference.
Persistent fictional or declared world rules, institutions and systems underlying the scene.

body_form.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 얼굴 이외 해부학적 윤곽·국소 부피·근육·힘줄 형태이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 기관 형태도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 연결 구조·상대 비율·자세·의복 부피·비해부학적 물건 구조와 구별하며 생존 상태·종·건강·능력·정체성을 추정하지 않는다.

An explicitly declared anatomical depiction may describe represented organs only; its physical carrier remains an artifact.
A represented or artificial anatomical form does not alter or add a living actor/plant, and does not establish that its carrier is alive or that any depicted species exists physically.
Body weight, health, strength, biological age, origin, species, growth capacity, material chemistry or fabrication inferred from form.
Source owner, positive form and actual application scope must be explicit; metadata, source effects, an optional member/profile or an actor/plant/representation role word alone is not a form fact.

A biological flower and a fabric rosette may occur in the same record, but anatomical form is assessed only on the declared biological flower or explicit anatomical depiction; cloth-fold form remains on the garment/craft owner.

exposure.description: Recorded exposure, clipping and preservation of tonal information, separate from incident light level.
exposure.description_ko: 기록 노출과 톤 범위: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Recorded exposure, clipping and preservation of tonal information, separate from incident light level.

expression.description: Observable facial or eye-area response belonging to one declared human or animal, or visibly presented by an explicitly declared artificial face or face representation. Includes expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks; not a proven private emotion, consciousness or hidden muscle action. Artificial and represented responses remain on their declared carriers.
expression.description_ko: 선언된 사람·동물의 관찰 가능한 얼굴·눈 주위 반응, 또는 명시된 인공 얼굴·얼굴 표현물에 실제로 드러난 표정 반응. 얼굴 기준점에 대한 표정성 눈썹 위치를 포함한다. 인공·묘사된 반응은 선언된 물체·표현물의 소유 범위에 머물며, 사적인 감정·의식·숨은 근육 작동이나 시선 방향·목표·눈맞춤을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: 시선 목표와 사적인 마음 상태를 표정 사실로 취급하지 않음
Eye or iris direction, a named gaze target or camera/participant engagement alone; these properties require their own evidence and roles.
Consciousness, absence of mind, actual emotion, personality, intention, successful perception or hidden muscle operation inferred from an expression, including empty-looking machine gaze.
Face shape or proportions, sensor/optical-iris hardware, material, skin finish, grooming or cosmetic line alone without a positively declared facial response.

An artificial or represented facial response does not imply living skin, biological eyes or eyelids, newly added facial parts, a living carrier or an additional human/animal. Preserve the actual artificial or representation owner; do not convert it to biological anatomy.

Metadata, old slot names/effects, an optional member/profile, or an actor/object/representation owner label alone cannot supply a face, facial response or unconditional application scope. Intrinsic source conditions and independently frozen binding conditions remain conjunctive and unchanged.
includes: Observable facial or eye-area response of one declared human or animal, including expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks, without proving private emotion.

An explicitly declared artificial face presenting an empty-looking machine gaze or a too-precisely held social expression. The source must positively describe the visible facial response; robot identity or sensor hardware alone is insufficient.

A visible expression explicitly described on one declared face representation remains owned by that representation and its carrier. It neither creates a living actor nor transfers a depicted response to another subject. A generic facial resemblance or ornament label alone is insufficient.

eye_detail.description: Owned local eye structure, iris color and surface appearance, distinct from gaze and surrounding cosmetics.
eye_detail.description_ko: 눈의 색·구조·관찰 가능한 국소 속성: 대체 안구 연결·충혈·눈물은 추가 역할; 일반 외모와 시선 관계를 구별
excludes: 대체 안구 연결·충혈·눈물은 추가 역할; 일반 외모와 시선 관계를 구별
includes: Owned local eye structure, iris color and surface appearance, distinct from gaze and surrounding cosmetics.

gaze_direction.description: Owned eye or iris orientation toward a direction in the selected frame, independent of head orientation, a named gaze target and viewer engagement.
gaze_direction.description_ko: 같은 주체 눈·홍채의 선택 프레임 내 방향. 머리 방향·시선의 명명 대상·눈맞춤 여부와 독립하며 감은 눈이나 동공 모양으로 방향을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: Head or body turn alone.
Eye closure, pupil shape or private intent.
Named gaze target or engagement alone.
includes: Upward iris direction without a named target.
An authored over-shoulder eye direction when that branch is selected.

gaze_engagement.description: Declared visual engagement with the camera or another participant, separate from mere eye direction or closure.
gaze_engagement.description_ko: 카메라·다른 참여자와 맺는 시선 관계: 현재 시선 방향·목표·눈 감음과 겹침; engagement 의미와 표정 요소를 재분류
excludes: 현재 시선 방향·목표·눈 감음과 겹침; engagement 의미와 표정 요소를 재분류
includes: Declared visual engagement with the camera or another participant, separate from mere eye direction or closure.

gaze_target.description: Target of the declared actor's gaze, with head orientation and eye state treated separately.
gaze_target.description_ko: 지정 눈·머리의 관찰 목표: 시선 방향·대상 위치·눈 감음을 구별; 몸 방향은 별도 소유 속성
excludes: 시선 방향·대상 위치·눈 감음을 구별; 몸 방향은 별도 소유 속성
includes: Target of the declared actor's gaze, with head orientation and eye state treated separately.

light_color.description: Color or color-temperature relation of declared illumination and its receivers, separate from local pigment or grading.
light_color.description_ko: 빛의 색: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Color or color-temperature relation of declared illumination and its receivers, separate from local pigment or grading.

light_direction.description: Incident light direction relative to a declared receiver and coordinate frame.
light_direction.description_ko: 지정 대상과 기준축에 대한 입사 방향: 카메라 방향·빛무늬와 구별; 배우 기준과 화면 기준 명시
excludes: 카메라 방향·빛무늬와 구별; 배우 기준과 화면 기준 명시
includes: Incident light direction relative to a declared receiver and coordinate frame.

light_intensity.description: Level of illumination reaching a declared receiver, distinct from recorded exposure and tone mapping.
light_intensity.description_ko: 대상에 도달하는 빛의 수준과 대비: 노출·톤 보존·클리핑·bloom이 섞임; image tone·optical artifact와 구별
excludes: 노출·톤 보존·클리핑·bloom이 섞임; image tone·optical artifact와 구별
includes: Level of illumination reaching a declared receiver, distinct from recorded exposure and tone mapping.

light_quality.description: Illumination softness, angular extent and resulting shadow transition, separate from intensity and image exposure.
light_quality.description_ko: 빛의 경계와 광질: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
A source device name or ambiguous named lighting look alone does not establish softness, angular extent or shadow transition.
includes: Illumination softness, angular extent and resulting shadow transition, separate from intensity and image exposure.

light_shape.description: Explicit spatial geometry of illumination, highlights or shadow boundaries on an identified receiving surface or within a declared illuminated spatial region.
light_shape.description_ko: 특정 수광 표면 또는 명시된 공간 영역에 나타나는 빛·하이라이트·그림자 경계의 공간 형태. 표면 무늬와 명시적 입체 광선 분포를 실제 범위에 맞게 구별한다.
excludes: A ray shape does not itself identify a lamp, camera, fog, smoke, dust particles or the physical scattering mechanism.
Spatial shape alone does not supply incident direction, light intensity, color temperature or the type of source.
Sacred/revelatory wording does not create a deity, religious event or an otherwise unmentioned world fact.
includes: A source-declared light pattern or shadow boundary on its actual receiving surface.
Explicit volumetric rays or other spatial light geometry can use their declared spatial region; a physical receiving surface is not compulsory for that meaning.
Preserve the source geometry, carrier and actual light/receiver relation. The source may require additional independently grounded owners.

light_type.description: Light-source type and emission mechanism, distinct from exposure trails and image artifacts.
light_type.description_ko: 광원의 종류와 발생 방식: 긴 노출 궤적은 motion_rendering 계열; 광원 정체와 영상 흔적 구별
excludes: 긴 노출 궤적은 motion_rendering 계열; 광원 정체와 영상 흔적 구별
A named day phase or lighting look alone does not identify a source type or emission mechanism.
includes: Light-source type and emission mechanism, distinct from exposure trails and image artifacts.

lighting.description: A coherent illumination setup combining source, spatial placement and receiving surfaces.
lighting.description_ko: 소유자·배치·광질이 연결된 조명 구성: 단일 광원 종류와 여러 속성의 완결된 구성을 구별; 하위 속성 자동 태깅 금지
excludes: 단일 광원 종류와 여러 속성의 완결된 구성을 구별; 하위 속성 자동 태깅 금지
A named lighting look alone, without positively declared source, placement and receiving-surface relations, does not establish a complete illumination setup.
includes: A coherent illumination setup combining source, spatial placement and receiving surfaces.

liquid_inclusion.description: Individually distinguishable particles, aggregates or bounded gas pockets located within an explicitly declared continuous liquid, including units at a submerged surface, with both units and liquid host grounded.
liquid_inclusion.description_ko: 명시된 연속 액체 내부에 있는 분리되어 보이는 입자·응집체·경계가 있는 기포와 그 배치. 잠긴 표면에 붙은 단위도 포함하되, 액체 매질과 내부 단위 각각의 근거를 요구한다.
excludes: Airborne droplets or dust, unresolved fog/haze, and optical-path or image-plane artifacts.
Surface foam texture without an explicit interior liquid host relation.
Bubbles trapped in a declared solid ice body; a broad material-inclusion extension needs additional solid-host evidence.
Liquid material, color, refraction or surface texture alone without distinct internal units.
Unstated chemical identity, dissolved oxygen, reaction quantity, source cause, current, polarity, sinking speed, breathing or safety inferred from the units.
includes: Separate suspended aggregates in a declared water column.
Bounded gas pockets with the surrounding water continuing around them.
Distinct illuminated particles in a declared underwater medium; small bubbles at submerged electrode surfaces.

location.description: Physical place and structural setting of the scene, distinct from use state or world rules.
location.description_ko: 장면이 놓인 장소와 공간 구조: 공간의 사용·손상 상태는 space_condition; 대기 중 사건과 장소 자체를 구별
excludes: 공간의 사용·손상 상태는 space_condition; 대기 중 사건과 장소 자체를 구별
includes: Physical place and structural setting of the scene, distinct from use state or world rules.

makeup_decoration.description: Cosmetic painted or attached skin decoration, distinct from natural markings and garment ornament.
makeup_decoration.description_ko: 피부에 붙이거나 그린 화장 장식: 자연 점·흉터·문신과 구별; 신체·얼굴 외 영역도 명시된 화장 맥락 필요
excludes: 자연 점·흉터·문신과 구별; 신체·얼굴 외 영역도 명시된 화장 맥락 필요
includes: Cosmetic painted or attached skin decoration, distinct from natural markings and garment ornament.

mood.description: Emotional atmosphere or proposed affective reading of the scene, not a measured state of air or a proven private emotion.
mood.description_ko: 장면이 제안하는 정서와 분위기 해석: 공기 중 안개·먼지와 구별; 인물의 실제 마음을 확인했다고 주장하지 않음
excludes: 공기 중 안개·먼지와 구별; 인물의 실제 마음을 확인했다고 주장하지 않음
includes: Emotional atmosphere or proposed affective reading of the scene, not a measured state of air or a proven private emotion.

narrative_clue.description: An owned visible clue supporting a declared event interpretation, with observation and inferred chronology kept separate.
narrative_clue.description_ko: 서사 해석의 단서: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: An owned visible clue supporting a declared event interpretation, with observation and inferred chronology kept separate.

narrative_phase.description: Selected instant or phase within an explicitly declared human, natural, mechanical or other event, distinct from clock time, a named occasion and inferred chronology.
narrative_phase.description_ko: 명시된 인간·자연·기계 등 사건 안에서 선택한 순간이나 단계. 하루 시각·행사 명목과 구별하며 사건의 원인·완료·연속 경과를 추론하지 않는다.
excludes: Clock time, season, historical era and the name of an occasion alone.
An inferred preceding cause, unmentioned event, completed outcome or elapsed sequence.
Do not infer rainfall from wetness or a clock time from low tide; a phase requires its explicit source event relation.
includes: Explicit before/after/during relations and selected natural-event phases, including an already declared loading event, rainfall or tide.
Human participation is not required. Existing source conditions and actual event/carrier identity remain mandatory.
A procedure operation or material transformation can additionally have its own role; a selected event phase alone does not supply the operation or transformation.

object_structure.description: Visible non-anatomical geometry, bounded parts and structural connections owned by one declared physical object or fixture, independent of its scene role, frame placement and current use state.
object_structure.description_ko: 선언된 물리적 물체·설비 자체의 비해부학적 형상, 경계가 있는 부품과 구조적 연결. 장면에서 맡는 용도·프레임 배치·현재 사용 상태와 구별하며, 몸·의복 특화 구조의 소유 범위를 보존한다.
excludes: Anatomical form, pose or continuity, including depicted anatomy whose representation ownership must remain explicit.
Frame arrangement, camera viewpoint, relative prop placement or image acuity alone.
Current open/closed, use, damage or readiness state without a separately evidenced structural feature.
Material identity or repeated surface microstructure alone; abstract two-dimensional graphic-path geometry alone.

A garment-specific construction fact already fully owned by garment_detail does not receive a duplicate generic role for that same fact. Simultaneous roles require separately evidenced properties or distinct owned components.
An optional garment member/profile cannot supply unconditional garment ownership or garment type to a generic parent.
includes: A declared case hinge and separately bounded disc recess; phone halves joined at their hinge.
A named strap assembly with a bar and incoming/returning strap path; a generic attached textile panel with its own bounded edge.
An identified fixture part and its structural joint; no claim of hidden manufacture or performance.

offscreen_context.description: Explicitly declared off-frame participants, events or space and their visible relation, not automatically added actors.
offscreen_context.description_ko: 화면 밖 맥락: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Explicitly declared off-frame participants, events or space and their visible relation, not automatically added actors.

participant_role.description: Explicit participation or relational role of a declared participant, whether primary or secondary, without inferring identity, occupation or a new counterpart from appearance.
participant_role.description_ko: 주·보조 구분 없이 이미 명시된 참여자의 참여상·관계상 역할. 외모에서 정체·직업·관계를 추론하거나 역할 이름만으로 상대역을 추가하지 않는다.
excludes: Off-frame placement, a back view and person count belong to their independently supported framing/count roles.
A rival/partner label does not itself create another participant or establish actual identity, occupation, disposition or a performed interaction.
Role truth and tag fit remain separate from effect permission; a prerequisite role cannot authorize a new role or relationship.
includes: A declared participant role can belong to either the primary or another existing participant. The source must identify the actual role carrier and any independently required relation endpoints.

physical_motion.description: Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.
physical_motion.description_ko: 물리 움직임 상태와 촬영된 움직임 표현: 정지·깜빡임·카메라 흔들림·영상 궤적이 섞임; owner와 image plane별 분리 여부 결정
excludes: 정지·깜빡임·카메라 흔들림·영상 궤적이 섞임; owner와 image plane별 분리 여부 결정
includes: Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.

prop_placement.description: Position and orientation of owned props relative to named actors, surfaces and boundaries.
prop_placement.description_ko: 소품의 방향·배치·주체와의 공간 관계: 막대 방향뿐 아니라 장벽·주머니·둘레가 섞임; 물건 상태는 prop_state
excludes: 막대 방향뿐 아니라 장벽·주머니·둘레가 섞임; 물건 상태는 prop_state
includes: Position and orientation of owned props relative to named actors, surfaces and boundaries.

prop_state.description: Owned object's current use, attachment, readiness, damage or arrangement state, with occupational context optional.
prop_state.description_ko: 물건의 사용·정리·고정·손상 상태: 업무 소품으로만 한정할 근거가 약함; duty는 맥락 조건으로 보존
excludes: 업무 소품으로만 한정할 근거가 약함; duty는 맥락 조건으로 보존
includes: Owned object's current use, attachment, readiness, damage or arrangement state, with occupational context optional.

proxemics.description: Physical spacing and access barriers between declared participants, without automatically inferring intimacy or intent.
proxemics.description_ko: 참여자 간 간격과 접근·차단 배치: 거리로 감정·관계를 자동 추론하지 않음; distance_narrative의 물리 요소 이관 검토
excludes: 거리로 감정·관계를 자동 추론하지 않음; distance_narrative의 물리 요소 이관 검토
includes: Physical spacing and access barriers between declared participants, without automatically inferring intimacy or intent.

publication_caption_context.description: Context of an external publication caption and how it frames interpretation, not text inside the image.
publication_caption_context.description_ko: 게시 문구와 사진 해석의 맥락: 이미지 안의 글자와 분리; 현재 성인 SNS·외모 평가 문구 편향
excludes: 이미지 안의 글자와 분리; 현재 성인 SNS·외모 평가 문구 편향
includes: Context of an external publication caption and how it frames interpretation, not text inside the image.

scale_relation.description: Comparative size relation between explicitly identified entities with a stated depth or perspective basis.
scale_relation.description_ko: 둘 이상의 명시된 대상 간 크기 관계: 절대 크기·원근 왜곡과 구별; 비교 기준과 깊이 관계를 보존
excludes: 절대 크기·원근 왜곡과 구별; 비교 기준과 깊이 관계를 보존
includes: Comparative size relation between explicitly identified entities with a stated depth or perspective basis.

shadow_relation.description: Declared caster, receiving surface and shadow correspondence, separate from reflection and light-level claims.
shadow_relation.description_ko: 그림자 대응 관계: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Declared caster, receiving surface and shadow correspondence, separate from reflection and light-level claims.

aftermath_trace.description_ko: 명시된 사건 뒤 남은 물리 흔적: 진행 중 서리·색 탈색·준비 상태가 섞임; 사건 결과인지 일반 표면 상태인지 구별
excludes: 진행 중 서리·색 탈색·준비 상태가 섞임; 사건 결과인지 일반 표면 상태인지 구별
includes: Owned physical residue of an explicitly declared prior event, distinct from an arbitrary surface state or ongoing process.

age_presentation.description: Explicitly declared age range or visible age presentation of an identified carrier or its explicitly owned local region; local appearance does not establish whole-owner chronological age, and intrinsic adult restrictions remain unchanged.
age_presentation.description_ko: 대상 또는 실제로 소유된 국소 영역의 명시된 연령 범위·보이는 연령 표현. 국소적인 나이 들어 보임·젊어 보임을 주체 전체의 실제 연령으로 확대하지 않으며, 기존 성인 제한은 그대로 누적한다.
excludes: Generic matte/glossy/rough texture, synthetic-skin material, wrinkles or a skin-region name alone without explicitly declared age presentation.
Chronological age, birth/manufacture history, adulthood, species, identity, health or family inferred from local skin or a provenance label.
Aged finish on non-skin material, weathering or damage alone is not subject/region visible age presentation merely because the adjective old/aged appears.

Part ownership is not equivalence: local region age appearance cannot be moved to the whole owner or another region. Distinct actual regions can legitimately have contrasting values on the same whole owner.

Selected age appearance remains E; explicit existing declared-age prerequisites retain P and cannot be used as permission to mutate locked age. Adult/human/domain source guards are neither inferred nor removed.
includes: Keep explicitly declared whole-carrier age range and visible age presentation, without inferring real chronological age from appearance.

An explicitly aged-looking versus young-looking owned skin-region contrast is local visible age presentation. Retain each actual region and owner; no new person, baby, exact age, family relation or global aged/young assignment follows.
A represented or synthetic carrier only receives the visible age presentation actually stated for its own region; representation identity alone is not a living age fact.

When one selection explicitly expresses both local skin microtexture and age appearance, appearance and age are two permission projections of that same semantic selection. Author both footprints consistently under the current proof contract; this is not an instruction for engine inference, automatic duplication or removal of locks.

ambient_particle.description: Individually distinguishable airborne particles or droplets and their spatial distribution, separate from an unresolved haze or fog optical field.
ambient_particle.description_ko: 공기 중에서 개별 형상·점·궤적으로 구별되는 입자·물방울과 그 분포. 물리적으로 미립자를 포함하더라도 개별 입자 없이 연속 감쇠장으로만 표현된 안개·연무는 atmospheric_medium이며, 수중 입자·영상 입자·표면 방울과 구별한다.
excludes: An unresolved haze or fog field described only through spatial attenuation or contrast loss.
Underwater particles or bubbles, image-plane grain and droplets attached to a surface.
A living airborne animal needs its own declared subject/participant evidence; the particle slot does not add one.
includes: Individually distinguishable airborne particles or droplets and their spatial distribution, separate from an unresolved haze or fog optical field.

anatomical_connection.description: Ownership and continuity, articulation, attachment or explicitly intended separation of anatomical parts of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation; non-anatomical artifact joins remain separate.
anatomical_connection.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 해부학적 부위 소유·연속·관절·부착 또는 명시적으로 의도된 분리이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 꽃·잎·자기 줄기 연결도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 형태·비율·단순 접촉·비해부학적 공예물 접합과 구별하며 생존·성장·종을 추정하지 않는다.
evidence_terms: bloom attached to its own stem
excludes: Anatomical contour, regional volume, relative proportion or part names alone without an actual ownership, continuity, articulation, attachment or intended-separation proposition.
Touching, nearness, overlap or visual alignment of separately owned subjects/objects alone; contact does not merge anatomy or establish a shared biological owner.

Object hinges, hardware branches, textile/lace/paper flower assemblies and floral graphic-path joins alone. Depicted anatomical connection requires an explicitly declared anatomical depiction and remains scoped there, never inferred live continuity.

Continuity/attachment does not prove that an owner is alive, growing, functional, healthy, a particular species or made by a particular process; a cut or depicted botanical part does not gain a hidden whole plant.

An artifact or picture cannot alter/add a living actor or plant merely because its design resembles a biological part. Actor/plant/representation owner labels, source effects and optional members/profiles are not independent anatomical evidence.
includes: Ownership and continuity, articulation or explicitly intended separation of declared human or other animal anatomical parts, retaining each actual owner and endpoint.

The declared botanical bloom remaining attached to its own woody stem; separate blossoms attaching along the same continuous branch; leaves belonging to that same declared plant/branch. Source-stated absence or separation is retained without inventing extra organs.

Explicit anatomical attachment/continuity within a declared representation remains on the represented anatomy. A flat ornament path or assembled craft junction alone does not establish an anatomical relation.

Where a fabric rosette and a separate existing biological flower coexist, their distinct owners remain distinct: the flower own petal/stem relation cannot be donated to the garment, and cloth attachment cannot be recast as plant growth.

apparatus_pov.description: View through an identified aperture, optical apparatus or observation surface.
apparatus_pov.description_ko: 물리 구멍·광학 장치·관찰 매체를 통한 시야: 열영상·스캐너는 취득 방식도 관련; 카메라 종류·프레임 모양과 독립 근거 필요
excludes: 열영상·스캐너는 취득 방식도 관련; 카메라 종류·프레임 모양과 독립 근거 필요
includes: View through an identified aperture, optical apparatus or observation surface.

atmospheric_medium.description: Continuous or unresolved air, haze or fog and its spatial optical response, separate from individually distinguishable airborne particles, camera-path artifacts and emotional atmosphere.
atmospheric_medium.description_ko: 공기·안개·연무가 연속 또는 비분해 광학장으로 만드는 공간 감쇠·대비·가시성 상태. 안개의 물리적 미립자 유무를 사진으로 판정하지 않으며, 개별 공기 입자·물방울 형상은 ambient_particle, 촬영 광학 경로의 베일은 lens_artifact, 정서는 mood로 구별한다.
excludes: Individually distinguishable airborne particle or droplet units alone.
Camera-path veiling flare, image-plane grain or encoding damage.
Emotional mood, an inferred weather cause, or unobserved chemical composition.
includes: Continuous or unresolved air, haze or fog and its spatial optical response, separate from individually distinguishable airborne particles, camera-path artifacts and emotional atmosphere.

attire_context.description: Declared role, culture, era or ceremony informing attire, separate from general garment construction.
attire_context.description_ko: 역할·문화·시대·의례를 명시한 복식 맥락: 일반 의복 구성과 분리; 전통 복식을 코스프레와 동일시하지 않음
excludes: 일반 의복 구성과 분리; 전통 복식을 코스프레와 동일시하지 않음
includes: Declared role, culture, era or ceremony informing attire, separate from general garment construction.

background_element.description: Declared secondary entities and structures in the background, separate from primary subjects and whole-place state.
background_element.description_ko: 배경 요소: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Declared secondary entities and structures in the background, separate from primary subjects and whole-place state.

body_form.description: Owned non-facial anatomical contour, regional volume or visible muscle and tendon form of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation. Independent of connection topology, relative proportions, pose, garment fit and non-anatomical artifact construction.
body_form.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 얼굴 이외 해부학적 윤곽·국소 부피·근육·힘줄 형태이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 기관 형태도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 연결 구조·상대 비율·자세·의복 부피·비해부학적 물건 구조와 구별하며 생존 상태·종·건강·능력·정체성을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: Body/plant region names, biological class words or connection topology alone without an independently stated anatomical contour or regional form.
Relative proportions, pose, facial geometry, garment fit or non-anatomical object/garment construction alone.

Floral graphic paths, repeating vegetal ornament, branch-shaped hardware or fabric/paper/lace flower parts do not become biological anatomy from resemblance or petal/stem labels. An explicitly declared anatomical depiction may describe represented organs only; its physical carrier remains an artifact.
A represented or artificial anatomical form does not alter or add a living actor/plant, and does not establish that its carrier is alive or that any depicted species exists physically.
Body weight, health, strength, biological age, origin, species, growth capacity, material chemistry or fabrication inferred from form.
Source owner, positive form and actual application scope must be explicit; metadata, source effects, an optional member/profile or an actor/plant/representation role word alone is not a form fact.
includes: Restrained visible muscle planes on a declared human or other animal; a localized neck vein contour or gluteal-thigh surface fold.

Large distinct floral segments forming an open cup on the declared botanical bloom; broad bounded leaf form or layered flower-organ form on its own declared plant owner. Plant form is not a claim of physiological life, growth capacity or species identification.

Explicitly depicted biological anatomy, including represented botanical organ form, stays on its declared representation. The source must actually describe anatomical form, not merely a floral style, motif or generic craft part.

A biological flower and a fabric rosette may occur in the same record, but anatomical form is assessed only on the declared biological flower or explicit anatomical depiction; cloth-fold form remains on the garment/craft owner.

body_hair.description: Owned regional body-hair density, length, distribution, skin attachment, individual-fiber thickness and pigmentation, separate from skin finish, scalp hair, facial hair and eyebrow or lash styling.
body_hair.description_ko: 지정 피부 부위에 소유된 체모의 밀도·길이·분포·피부 부착·개별 털 굵기·색소. 피부 마감·두발·수염·눈썹 및 속눈썹 연출과 구별하며, 선택한 속성만 적용한다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
Scalp-hair arrangement/color, facial-hair styling, brow/lash styling, skin pigment or skin optical finish alone.
Thickness or pigmentation does not prove age, sex, hormones, health, numerical composition or history.
includes: Owned regional body-hair density, length, distribution, skin attachment, individual-fiber thickness and pigmentation, separate from skin finish, scalp hair, facial hair and eyebrow or lash styling.

body_marking.description: Bounded natural, declared or applied markings on the owned body surface of an explicitly declared human or nonhuman actor, including a selected creature or machine-body design; owner and surface boundaries remain explicit.
body_marking.description_ko: 명시된 인간 또는 비인간 주체의 몸 표면에 한정된 국소 표식과 색 경계. 선택된 생물·기계 몸 디자인도 포함하되 기존 소유자·매체를 유지하고 인간 참조를 비인간으로 변환하지 않는다.
excludes: 화장·자연 표식·흉터 원인은 맥락 필요; 의복 무늬와 소유자 구별
A separate garment, bracelet, projected/cast shadow, emitted light or standalone object pattern cannot substitute for a body-surface mark.
A marking alone does not establish biological species, origin, injury/disease history or actual light emission.
Catalog permission never changes a candidate nonhuman-only guard or authorizes conversion of a referenced human.
includes: Bounded natural, declared or applied markings on the owned body surface of an explicitly declared human or nonhuman actor, including a selected creature or machine-body design; owner and surface boundaries remain explicit.

body_orientation.description: Explicit orientation of an identified body or relative rotation of its declared connected regions, including biological, mechanical and represented bodies.
body_orientation.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸과 명시적으로 연결된 부위의 축 방향·상대 회전. 카메라 방향·전신 지지 자세·눈의 시선과 구별한다.
excludes: Camera position, body support pose, eye-gaze direction and a scene object facing the frame are not interchangeable.
Standing or an activity alone does not supply a rotation, connected region, angle, axis or reference basis.
Do not infer eyes, a nose, joints or a human torso from the role name or a mechanical subject.
includes: A declared body axis orientation or relative rotation of connected regions, with the actual regions, relation and reference basis stated.
A nonhuman or represented body can qualify on the same literal contract. Actual source conditions and available owner regions still apply.

body_pose.description: Explicit whole-body posture, support or articulation of an identified biological, mechanical or represented body, without inferring unmentioned anatomy.
body_pose.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸의 명시적 전신 자세·지지·관절 배치. 실제 대상과 몸의 범위를 확인하며 언급하지 않은 신체 부위나 지지 접촉을 추론하지 않는다.
excludes: A rigid object shape, a camera viewpoint or an activity word alone does not establish a whole-body pose.
Relative rotation of body axes, hand articulation, concrete action and rendered motion have separate roles when supported.
Do not turn an unavailable body or limb into a new entity to satisfy a pose.
includes: Explicit standing, sitting, lying or other whole-body posture of a declared human, animal, robot or represented body.
Preserve the actual support and articulated connections when declared. Standing alone does not supply feet, legs, a supporting ground contact or a human body.
Decide effect versus a required existing posture from the whole source; source-specific category and domain conditions remain cumulative.

body_region.description: Named anatomical region or selected body part, distinct from the obligation to prove its visibility.
body_region.description_ko: 선택된 신체 부위와 관찰 범위: 부위 자체와 이를 보여야 하는 검증 의무를 분리; framing·해부 연결과 연계
excludes: 부위 자체와 이를 보여야 하는 검증 의무를 분리; framing·해부 연결과 연계
includes: Named anatomical region or selected body part, distinct from the obligation to prove its visibility.

brow_style.description: Owned eyebrow-hair shape, strand arrangement, grooming or cosmetic line, separate from expression-related elevation, lowering or convergence of the brow relative to facial landmarks.
brow_style.description_ko: 눈썹 털의 형태·결·정리 또는 화장 선. 얼굴 기준점에 대한 눈썹의 상승·하강·미간 수축 같은 표정 위치와 구별한다.
excludes: 자연 털과 화장 선은 적용 맥락으로 구별; 눈썹을 눈 화장 전체로 확대하지 않음
Expression-related brow elevation, lowering or convergence alone belongs to expression; it does not establish grooming, a cosmetic line or a private emotion.
includes: Owned eyebrow-hair shape, strand arrangement, grooming or cosmetic line, separate from expression-related elevation, lowering or convergence of the brow relative to facial landmarks.

calendar_context.description: Explicit day type or calendar interval such as weekday, weekend or eve, distinct from clock time and named occasion.
calendar_context.description_ko: 달력 시점: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Explicit day type or calendar interval such as weekday, weekend or eve, distinct from clock time and named occasion.

camera_direction.description: Camera viewing axis and roll relative to the subject, distinct from height, distance and body orientation.
camera_direction.description_ko: 카메라 관측 방향과 대상 대비 각도: 높이·관찰 위치·몸 방향이 섞임; 관측축과 위치를 별도 표현
excludes: 높이·관찰 위치·몸 방향이 섞임; 관측축과 위치를 별도 표현
includes: Camera viewing axis and roll relative to the subject, distinct from height, distance and body orientation.

camera_distance.description: Physical camera-to-subject distance or declared observer separation, independent of shot scale and lens choice.
camera_distance.description_ko: 카메라 거리: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Physical camera-to-subject distance or declared observer separation, independent of shot scale and lens choice.

camera_height.description: Camera height relative to a declared reference, distinct from viewing axis and distance.
camera_height.description_ko: 지정 기준면·대상 대비 카메라 높이: 카메라 기울기·관찰자 사회적 역할과 구별; 높이만으로 광학을 확정하지 않음
excludes: 카메라 기울기·관찰자 사회적 역할과 구별; 높이만으로 광학을 확정하지 않음
includes: Camera height relative to a declared reference, distinct from viewing axis and distance.

camera_movement.description: Declared camera movement or support stability during capture, separate from subject movement and its recorded blur.
camera_movement.description_ko: 카메라 움직임: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Declared camera movement or support stability during capture, separate from subject movement and its recorded blur.

camera_type.description: Declared acquisition device class, distinct from its mounting and from the image's imitation of a device look.
camera_type.description_ko: 선택된 촬영 장치와 영상 취득 계열: 카메라 외관·장착 방식·매체 표현을 분리; 장치가 픽셀에 보이는지 별도 판정
excludes: 카메라 외관·장착 방식·매체 표현을 분리; 장치가 픽셀에 보이는지 별도 판정
includes: Declared acquisition device class, distinct from its mounting and from the image's imitation of a device look.

capture_configuration.description: Arrangement of camera, operator, support, subject and reflecting surfaces during capture.
capture_configuration.description_ko: 운용자·지지·장치·반사면의 촬영 구성: 셀피 세부만으로 한정하지 않음; core의 camera.capture_mode 필드와 슬롯 ID를 구별

capture_context.description: Purpose, access, observational circumstances and recording context of photography, not apparatus geometry.
capture_context.description_ko: 촬영 목적·기록 상황·접근과 관찰 조건: 장치 배치와 물리 촬영 구성은 capture_configuration; 기록 경위는 픽셀 사실이 아님
excludes: 장치 배치와 물리 촬영 구성은 capture_configuration; 기록 경위는 픽셀 사실이 아님
includes: Purpose, access, observational circumstances and recording context of photography, not apparatus geometry.

character_contrast.description: Contrast between a declared character's visible bearing, local response, role or status.
character_contrast.description_ko: 한 인물의 태도·반응·역할 사이 대비: 권위와 주도권·계급 대비도 포함됨; 감정 모순으로만 정의하면 현재 후보 의미를 축소

includes: Contrast between a declared character's visible bearing, local response, role or status.

character_intent.description: Explicit character goal or intended response used as narrative context, not a proven private mental state.

exposure.description: Recorded exposure, clipping and preservation of tonal information, separate from incident light level.

expression.description: Observable facial or eye-area response belonging to one declared human or animal, or visibly presented by an explicitly declared artificial face or face representation. Includes expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks; not a proven private emotion, consciousness or hidden muscle action. Artificial and represented responses remain on their declared carriers.
expression.description_ko: 선언된 사람·동물의 관찰 가능한 얼굴·눈 주위 반응, 또는 명시된 인공 얼굴·얼굴 표현물에 실제로 드러난 표정 반응. 얼굴 기준점에 대한 표정성 눈썹 위치를 포함한다. 인공·묘사된 반응은 선언된 물체·표현물의 소유 범위에 머물며, 사적인 감정·의식·숨은 근육 작동이나 시선 방향·목표·눈맞춤을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: 시선 목표와 사적인 마음 상태를 표정 사실로 취급하지 않음
Eye or iris direction, a named gaze target or camera/participant engagement alone; these properties require their own evidence and roles.
Consciousness, absence of mind, actual emotion, personality, intention, successful perception or hidden muscle operation inferred from an expression, including empty-looking machine gaze.
Face shape or proportions, sensor/optical-iris hardware, material, skin finish, grooming or cosmetic line alone without a positively declared facial response.

An artificial or represented facial response does not imply living skin, biological eyes or eyelids, newly added facial parts, a living carrier or an additional human/animal. Preserve the actual artificial or representation owner; do not convert it to biological anatomy.

Metadata, old slot names/effects, an optional member/profile, or an actor/object/representation owner label alone cannot supply a face, facial response or unconditional application scope. Intrinsic source conditions and independently frozen binding conditions remain conjunctive and unchanged.
includes: Observable facial or eye-area response of one declared human or animal, including expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks, without proving private emotion.

An explicitly declared artificial face presenting an empty-looking machine gaze or a too-precisely held social expression. The source must positively describe the visible facial response; robot identity or sensor hardware alone is insufficient.

A visible expression explicitly described on one declared face representation remains owned by that representation and its carrier. It neither creates a living actor nor transfers a depicted response to another subject. A generic facial resemblance or ornament label alone is insufficient.

includes: Owned local eye structure, iris color and surface appearance, distinct from gaze and surrounding cosmetics.

eye_makeup_line.description: Path and boundary of cosmetic eyeliner around the declared eye.

includes: An explicitly selected fetish styling context with appropriate adult scope, not a material-only inference.

film_emulation.description: A coherent visual emulation of a named film or photographic medium, without claiming the medium was actually used.

footwear.description_ko: 소유된 신발의 종류·구조·외관, 또는 명시된 착용자의 지정 발 부위가 신발·양말 없이 드러난 상태. 부재 상태는 존재하지 않는 신발이 아니라 같은 착용자의 해당 발 부위에 결속한다. 국소 노출에서 두 발·전신 맨발을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: 신발 착용과 단독 물체 제시를 명시적으로 구별하며, 바닥 소품의 배치는 prop_placement로 별도 판단한다. 작은 신발 부류도 독립 속성을 표현하면 유효하다.
Missing, cropped or occluded footwear is not affirmative absence evidence; skin-colored or open-toe shoes cannot substitute for the selected uncovered-foot state.
Footwear contact/crop legibility alone selects neither shoe type nor an uncovered state.
No shoe entity is introduced or deleted by semantic qualification; local evidence does not establish both feet or whole-body absence.
includes: Declared footwear type, construction and appearance on an explicitly owned shoe object, or an explicitly selected local foot region visibly uncovered by footwear and socks. Bind an absence state to the wearer and named foot region, never to a nonexistent shoe; wearing and standalone-object use remain distinct.

garment_detail.description: Construction, topology, trim or local form of an identified garment, whether worn, displayed, standalone or represented, distinct from anatomy and material identity.
garment_detail.description_ko: 착용·전시·단독·묘사된 의복 자체의 구조·연결·트림·국소 형태. 실제 의복 소유자를 확인하며 인체 구조·피부 표식·재질 정체와 구별한다.
excludes: Cloth material or an unowned edge alone is not a garment construction detail.
A garment detail does not establish a wearer, anatomy, exposure, fit, material identity or clothing ensemble.
Do not remove any intrinsic source-specific human, adult or domain restriction.
includes: An actual garment-owned seam, cuff, hem, sleeve, trim or construction relation; an independently declared human wearer is not compulsory.
If a wearer, layering relation, support or attachment is required by the source, preserve that specific condition rather than deriving it from the slot.
Separately supported material, texture, fit, layering or state can have their own roles without duplicating the garment.

garment_fit.description: Relation of a garment's volume and contour to its declared wearer, without inferring body shape from clothing.
garment_fit.description_ko: 의복 핏: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.

includes: Current garment wear, fastening, wetness or deformation, separate from construction and body state.

gaze_direction.description: Owned eye or iris orientation toward a direction in the selected frame, independent of head orientation, a named gaze target and viewer engagement.
gaze_direction.description_ko: 같은 주체 눈·홍채의 선택 프레임 내 방향. 머리 방향·시선의 명명 대상·눈맞춤 여부와 독립하며 감은 눈이나 동공 모양으로 방향을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: Head or body turn alone.
Eye closure, pupil shape or private intent.
Named gaze target or engagement alone.
includes: Upward iris direction without a named target.
An authored over-shoulder eye direction when that branch is selected.

gaze_engagement.description: Declared visual engagement with the camera or another participant, separate from mere eye direction or closure.
gaze_engagement.description_ko: 카메라·다른 참여자와 맺는 시선 관계: 현재 시선 방향·목표·눈 감음과 겹침; engagement 의미와 표정 요소를 재분류
excludes: 현재 시선 방향·목표·눈 감음과 겹침; engagement 의미와 표정 요소를 재분류
includes: Declared visual engagement with the camera or another participant, separate from mere eye direction or closure.

gaze_target.description: Explicit target of an identified gaze carrier, including a declared human or animal, with actual gaze-bearing scope and target grounded separately from head orientation, eye state and visual engagement.
gaze_target.description_ko: 사람·동물을 포함한 명시된 시선 주체의 실제 관찰 목표. 시선 부위와 목표 소유 범위를 각각 증명하며, 머리 방향·눈 상태·눈맞춤·실제 인지 성공과 구별한다.
excludes: Head/body turn, pupil shape, eye closure, an empty-looking expression or a target location alone does not identify a gaze target.
A human/animal/robot/portrait label alone proves no eyes, gaze-bearing anatomy or performed gaze. Explicitly represented gaze remains on its represented carrier; biological anatomy is not donated.
Directed sensor/camera hardware, a lamp beam or device aiming alone is not biological or represented gaze. Artificial facial response alone is not gaze direction or a target.
Named target does not prove attention, successful seeing, consciousness, desire, camera awareness, engagement or target placement.
Do not add eyes, a face, phone or counterpart, or replace an independently selected secondary/background gaze carrier with a primary default.
includes: An explicitly declared human or animal looking at an identified existing target; source category does not change the same gaze-target meaning.
Looking into a phone camera supplies that named gaze target; it does not identify the camera actually recording the photograph or establish eye contact with the viewer.

Retain the exact gaze carrier, independently available relevant eye/gaze scope and actual target. Source/binding intrinsic restrictions stay conjunctive; select or preserve the gaze relation only as the whole source declares.

gender_presentation.description: Explicit visual gender presentation without inferring sex, gender identity, personality or orientation.
gender_presentation.description_ko: 성별 표현: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.

genre.description: Photographic genre and the conventions of the work, distinct from equipment and world rules.
genre.description_ko: 사진 작업의 장르와 표현 관습: 매체·세계 규칙·개별 촬영 장치와 구별; 현재 여러 분류가 섞임

grain_profile.description: Grain or stochastic noise distribution on the image plane, not physical material grain or airborne dust.
grain_profile.description_ko: 이미지 면의 입자와 노이즈 분포: 표면 질감·공기 먼지·렌즈 먼지와 구별

hair_color.description: Explicit color and color placement bounded to an identified hair region, wig or represented hair, distinct from scene grading and material identity.
hair_color.description_ko: 실제 모발 영역·가발·묘사된 머리에 한정된 명시적 색과 배치. 장면 색 보정·빛의 색·의복 색·재질 정체와 구별한다.
excludes: Illumination color, global image grading, general fur, a colored fiber object or an unowned color word alone is not hair-region color.
Do not infer dye chemistry, natural pigmentation, a wearer, follicles, hairstyle or another body region from the color.
A broader slot contract does not waive an intrinsic source-specific human or adult condition.

hair_style.description: Explicit shape, length, arrangement or strand topology of an identified hair region or wig, separate from its color and material identity.
hair_style.description_ko: 실제 모발 영역이나 가발의 명시적 형태·길이·배치·가닥 연결. 색·재질과 분리하며 자연 모발·가발·묘사된 머리의 실제 소유자를 구별한다.
excludes: A synthetic fiber sheen alone does not supply a hairstyle or a living hair root.
General animal fur, a braided rope, a body-hair region and a hair-color word are not automatically a head-hair arrangement.
Do not introduce a wearer, head, scalp, follicles, hair identity or a new physical strand connection from a style name.
includes: An explicitly declared hair or wig arrangement with its actual owned region and strand continuity.
A standalone wig or represented hair can qualify without inventing a human wearer or biological follicles.
Source-specific wearer/category conditions and existing-region prerequisites remain mandatory.

hand_pose.description: Static shape and articulation of owned hands and fingers, with support and contact represented separately.
hand_pose.description_ko: 소유 손의 정적 형태와 연결: 물건 사용 동작·손 접촉과 구별; 실제로 둘을 표현하면 다중 역할 허용

light_quality.description: Illumination softness, angular extent and resulting shadow transition, separate from intensity and image exposure.

A source device name or ambiguous named lighting look alone does not establish softness, angular extent or shadow transition.
includes: Illumination softness, angular extent and resulting shadow transition, separate from intensity and image exposure.

light_shape.description: Explicit spatial geometry of illumination, highlights or shadow boundaries on an identified receiving surface or within a declared illuminated spatial region.
light_shape.description_ko: 특정 수광 표면 또는 명시된 공간 영역에 나타나는 빛·하이라이트·그림자 경계의 공간 형태. 표면 무늬와 명시적 입체 광선 분포를 실제 범위에 맞게 구별한다.
excludes: A ray shape does not itself identify a lamp, camera, fog, smoke, dust particles or the physical scattering mechanism.
Spatial shape alone does not supply incident direction, light intensity, color temperature or the type of source.
Sacred/revelatory wording does not create a deity, religious event or an otherwise unmentioned world fact.

light_type.description: Light-source type and emission mechanism, distinct from exposure trails and image artifacts.

lip_color_placement.description: Bounded lip pigment regions, opacity, concentration and color transitions.

liquid_inclusion.description: Individually distinguishable particles, aggregates or bounded gas pockets located within an explicitly declared continuous liquid, including units at a submerged surface, with both units and liquid host grounded.
liquid_inclusion.description_ko: 명시된 연속 액체 내부에 있는 분리되어 보이는 입자·응집체·경계가 있는 기포와 그 배치. 잠긴 표면에 붙은 단위도 포함하되, 액체 매질과 내부 단위 각각의 근거를 요구한다.

Surface foam texture without an explicit interior liquid host relation.
Bubbles trapped in a declared solid ice body; a broad material-inclusion extension needs additional solid-host evidence.
Liquid material, color, refraction or surface texture alone without distinct internal units.
Unstated chemical identity, dissolved oxygen, reaction quantity, source cause, current, polarity, sinking speed, breathing or safety inferred from the units.
includes: Separate suspended aggregates in a declared water column.
Bounded gas pockets with the surrounding water continuing around them.
Distinct illuminated particles in a declared underwater medium; small bubbles at submerged electrode surfaces.
